_about: The /chicago-data/ hub, the home page's free tools section and the More free Chicago data strip on each data page (redesign, Oct 27, 2026). Groups are by the job a trade owner is doing. A live data page missing here still shows, under More Chicago data, with its own title and card. name is the short card title; cadence and source must match the page's workflow and its own source line. stat: a regex over the built page's own text (tags as ' | '), so the card's number is exactly what the page shows; no match means no number on the card. short: the card's one line (70 characters at most, no words the figure label already says). raw: true runs the pattern on the page's HTML instead (for a page whose text holds every view, like the snow board's hidden station and trigger views).
